Michael Schumacher won the most races at Circuit de Nevers Magny-Cours between 2000 and 2025, with 4 wins.

The retrieved race reports show these Magny-Cours winners:

| Year | Winner |
|---|---|
| 2000 | David Coulthard |
| 2001 | Michael Schumacher |
| 2002 | Michael Schumacher |
| 2003 | Ralf Schumacher |
| 2004 | Michael Schumacher |
| 2005 | Fernando Alonso |
| 2006 | Michael Schumacher |
| 2007 | Kimi Räikkönen |
| 2008 | Felipe Massa |

No Magny-Cours race turned up for 2009 or later, so I found no winners after 2008 there. Coulthard, Ralf Schumacher, Alonso, Räikkönen and Massa each won once.

ANSWER: Michael Schumacher
